title: H 3404 (124th General Assembly): Candidate, prohibit name of for President or Vice President to be printed on ballot unless evidence of being a natural born citizen
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.

(e_other_rule)
(section) SECTION 1 (new 7-13-345(A))
(quote) A candidate for President or Vice President of the United States may not have his name printed on a ballot in this State unless there is conclusive evidence that the candidate is a natural born citizen of the United States.
(section) SECTION 1 (new 7-13-345(B))
(quote) This section applies to a person, petitioner, or party placing the names of electors on the ballot.
(other) SECTION 2: takes effect upon approval by the Governor.
(other) version: 2020-12-09_Introduced (only version): no voter ID or voter-citizenship text; slot e holds a natural-born-citizen rule for presidential and vice-presidential candidates (same idea as H 3389 of 2009).
(other) note: This bill concerns presidential candidates, not voters. One version.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
